project_info.name: Athena OS
project_info.tech_stack: Django templates + Vanilla JS + CSS Custom Properties (Self-hosted assets)

design_philosophy.concept: Industrial Control Room Precision meets High-Clarity SaaS
fusion_elements: ISA-101 High-Performance HMI (Neutral low-fatigue base + high-signal status indicators)
Swiss Structural Grid & Typographic Contrast (Wide Display + Humanist Sans + Tactical Mono)
Tactical Industrial Aesthetic (Subtle grid borders, sharp glassmorphism, functional data density)
anti_patterns_avoided: No generic AI purple-blue gradients (#7351B7 forbidden)
No transparent headers without backdrop blur
No decorative green/blue noise that competes with alarm states

header_nav.styles: position: sticky; top: 0; z-index: 50; backdrop-filter: blur(12px); background: rgba(19, 25, 36, 0.85); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border); padding: 0.75rem 1.5rem; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between;

primary_button.styles: background-color: var(--accent-primary); color: #0b0f17; font-family: var(--font-body); font-weight: 600; padding: 0.625rem 1.25rem; border-radius: var(--radius-md); border: none; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 0.2s ease, transform 0.1s ease; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.5rem;

secondary_button.styles: background-color: transparent; color: var(--text-main); font-family: var(--font-body); font-weight: 500; padding: 0.625rem 1.25rem; border-radius: var(--radius-md); border: 1px solid var(--border); cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 0.2s ease, border-color 0.2s ease; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.5rem;

card.styles: background-color: var(--bg-surface); border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: var(--radius-lg); padding: 1.5rem; box-shadow: var(--shadow-card); transition: border-color 0.2s ease, transform 0.2s ease;

template_tile.styles: background-color: var(--bg-surface); border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: var(--radius-lg); padding: 1.25rem; cursor: pointer; transition: all 0.2s ease; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 0.75rem;
template_tile.hover: border-color: var(--accent-primary); background-color: var(--bg-surface-hover); transform: translateY(-2px);

status_chip.clear: background-color: var(--status-clear-bg); color: var(--status-clear); border: 1px solid var(--status-clear-border); padding: 0.25rem 0.75rem; border-radius: var(--radius-pill); font-family: var(--font-mono); font-size: 0.8125rem; font-weight: 600; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.375rem;
status_chip.attention: background-color: var(--status-attention-bg); color: var(--status-attention); border: 1px solid var(--status-attention-border); padding: 0.25rem 0.75rem; border-radius: var(--radius-pill); font-family: var(--font-mono); font-size: 0.8125rem; font-weight: 600; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.375rem;
status_chip.critical: background-color: var(--status-critical-bg); color: var(--status-critical); border: 1px solid var(--status-critical-border); padding: 0.25rem 0.75rem; border-radius: var(--radius-pill); font-family: var(--font-mono); font-size: 0.8125rem; font-weight: 600; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.375rem;

count_tile.styles: background-color: var(--bg-surface-alt); border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle); border-radius: var(--radius-md); padding: 1rem; text-align: left;
count_tile.number_style: font-family: var(--font-mono); font-size: 2rem; font-weight: 700; color: var(--text-main); line-height: 1.1;
count_tile.label_style: font-family: var(--font-body); font-size: 0.875rem; color: var(--text-muted); margin-top: 0.25rem;

dropzone.styles: border: 2px dashed var(--border); border-radius: var(--radius-lg); padding: 2.5rem 1.5rem; text-align: center; background-color: var(--bg-surface-alt); cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 0.2s ease, background-color 0.2s ease;

overlay_bounding_box.styles: position: absolute; border: 2px solid var(--accent-primary); background-color: rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.15); border-radius: var(--radius-sm); pointer-events: auto;
overlay_bounding_box.label_tag: position: absolute; top: -1.5rem; left: -2px; background-color: var(--accent-primary); color: #0b0f17; font-family: var(--font-mono); font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 700; padding: 0.1rem 0.4rem; border-radius: 2px 2px 0 0;

hero_section.headline: No IT Degree Needed. Count, Detect, and Inspect Anything with AI Vision.
hero_section.subheadline: Show Athena a photo or video, ask what you want to know, and get immediate contextual analysis for industrial operations, retail, parking, and facility safety.
hero_section.badge: Default: Open-Source Qwen VLM | Bring Your Own Model

how_it_works_3_steps.title: Upload or Pick a Template
how_it_works_3_steps.description: Choose from ready-made presets (Parking, Foot Traffic, Corrosion, PPE, Leaks) or write in plain English.

how_it_works_3_steps.title: Visual AI Context Engine Runs
how_it_works_3_steps.description: Our open-source Vision-Language Model reads the image, counts items, and analyzes structural context.

how_it_works_3_steps.title: Instant Actionable Inspection Report
how_it_works_3_steps.description: Get status verdicts (All Clear, Needs Attention, Critical), bounding highlights, exact counts, and recommended actions.

use_case_cards.title: Oil & Gas Industrial Inspection
use_case_cards.description: Detect corrosion, flange leaks, surface defects, and pipe degradation with severity scoring.

use_case_cards.title: Facility & Parking Occupancy
use_case_cards.description: Count free vs occupied parking spaces and monitor vehicle movement in real time.

use_case_cards.title: Retail Foot Traffic & Safety
use_case_cards.description: Track store traffic flows, detect hazard spills, and verify safety PPE compliance.

trust_section.headline: Open Source & Self-Hostable Trust
points: 100% Data Sovereignty — Run locally on your own infrastructure or cloud
No Vendor Lock-in — Connect Qwen VLM or any OpenAI-compatible Vision API endpoint
Built for Non-Technical Field Operations Teams

data_testid_guidelines.rule: All key interactive buttons, inputs, links, tabs, and status cards MUST contain readable data-testid attributes.

instructions_to_main_agent: Inject the CSS custom properties from css_custom_properties_template into web/projects/static/projects/console.css or a dedicated athena_theme.css file.
Implement the theme toggle on the top navigation bar so toggling updates [data-theme='light'] / [data-theme='dark'] on <html> or <body>.
Use plain vanilla JavaScript with clear event listeners for wizard transitions, modal dialogs, and image overlay interactions.
Ensure input elements are minimum 16px font size to prevent automatic zooming on iOS devices and maintain WCAG 2.2 AA accessibility.
Include all required data-testid attributes across templates and JS dynamic renders to support automated test coverage.
